anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Then lost lines at top of Witte p.112; 1 L. ca. 15 Z.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: The light of the world; possible.

choices.why: Stoic term for the governing part; keep the technical sense in plain words.

lemmas.lexica: LSJ/SVF: the governing part of the soul

pass_a_gloss: And we too, unless the true light rise for us perfectly and we see that our ruling-faculty has been perfectly illumined, shall not be able to sacrifice and eat the true sheep.
pass_b_english: And we too, unless the true light rises for us perfectly and we see that our ruling faculty has been perfectly illumined, shall not be able to sacrifice and eat the true sheep (John 1:9) (John 8:12).
source_text: Καὶ ἡμεῖς δὲ εἰ μὴ τέλειον τὸ φῶς ἡμῖν τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἀνατείλῃ καὶ ἴδωμεν ὡς πεφώτισται ἡμῶν τελείως τὸ ἡγεμονικόν, οὐ δυνησόμεθα τὸ ἀληθινὸν πρόβατον θῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν.]
